name: AM-1248
summary: AM-1248 is a drug that acts as a moderately potent agonist for both the cannabinoid receptors CB1 and CB2, but with some dispute between sources over its exact potency and selectivity.

pharmacology.text: AM-1248 is a drug that acts as a moderately potent agonist for both the cannabinoid receptors CB1 and CB2, but with some dispute between sources over its exact potency and selectivity.

uses.text: Replacing the 3-(1-naphthoyl) group found in many indole derived cannabinoid ligands, with an adamantoyl group, generally confers significant CB2 selectivity, but reasonable CB1 affinity and selectivity is retained when an N-methylpiperidin-2-ylmethyl substitution is used at the indole 1-position.

summaryZh: AM-1248，化學名：1-[(N-甲基-2-哌啶基)甲基]-3-(1-金剛烷基甲醯基)吲哚，分子式C26H34N2O，屬於亞歷山德羅斯·馬克里揚尼斯小組合成的金剛烷甲醯基吲哚類AM系列大麻素，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: Its bulky adamantane cage, a diamond-like block of carbon atoms, replaces the naphthalene ring used in most related compounds. That same cage shape appears in the antiviral drug amantadine.
fact.zh: 它龐大的金剛烷籠狀結構，是由碳原子組成的類鑽石方塊，取代了多數相關化合物所用的萘環。同樣的籠狀結構也出現在抗病毒藥物金剛烷胺中。
fact.zhHans: 它庞大的金刚烷笼状结构，是由碳原子组成的类钻石方块，取代了多数相关化合物所用的萘环。同样的笼状结构也出现在抗病毒药物金刚烷胺中。
